description: No change: Adam groups already use a decoupled-weight-decay AdamW implementation, and no AMScape optimizer is available.
No change: the script already runs bf16 autocast mixed precision.
Halve the uniform init scale of attention/MLP input weights (and value embeddings) by scaling s by 0.5.
Set ASPECT_RATIO to 32 and HEAD_DIM to 16, giving a narrower 256-dim model with 16 heads at depth 8.
Reduce UNEMBEDDING_LR from 0.004 to 0.001 to damp lm_head updates.
Double MATRIX_LR from 0.04 to 0.08 for the Muon matrix parameters.
Set WARMUP_RATIO from 0.0 to 0.05 to add a short linear LR warmup at the start of training.
Set DEVICE_BATCH_SIZE to 16 (more grad accumulation, same total batch) and use full-context attention in all layers (WINDOW_PATTERN "L").
Set DEVICE_BATCH_SIZE to 16 (more grad accumulation, same total batch) and use full-context attention in all layers (WINDOW_PATTERN "L").
Increase WARMDOWN_RATIO from 0.5 to 0.7 so the learning rate starts decaying earlier in the run.
No change: weight decay is already decoupled from the gradient update in both the AdamW and Muon steps.
Double TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE from 2**19 to 2**20 tokens per optimizer step (grad accumulation doubles automatically).
Add a short 2% linear LR warmup and make the warmdown follow a cosine curve instead of linear decay.
Reduce WEIGHT_DECAY from 0.2 to 0.05 for the Muon cautious weight decay.
Set ASPECT_RATIO from 64 to 96, which widens the model from 512 to 768 dim (6 heads) at depth 8.
Abort: ASPECT_RATIO 96 was already tested (slot 11, 1.1397, worse), and HEAD_DIM 110 is not a multiple of 8, so FA3 will likely reject it.
Raise MATRIX_LR from 0.04 to 0.06 for the Muon matrix parameters.
Apply Muon cautious weight decay only to MLP matrices (non-square shapes) by zeroing it for the square attention matrix groups.
Set WEIGHT_DECAY from 0.2 to 0.08 for the Muon cautious weight decay.
Replace the ReLU^2 MLP with a SwiGLU MLP (hidden width ~8/3*n_embd rounded to a multiple of 128, so the parameter count stays near the baseline).
Add a short 2% square-root-shaped LR warmup (fast initial rise, then flattening) by setting WARMUP_RATIO to 0.02 and using sqrt(progress/WARMUP_RATIO).
Abort: MATRIX_LR 0.08 was already tested and rejected in slot 3.
Apply Muon cautious weight decay only to the attention and MLP output projection (c_proj) matrices by splitting Muon groups by projection status and scaling the decayed weight decay per group.

issues: The diff changes only one hyperparameter: FINAL_LR_FRAC goes from 0.0 to 0.001. It does not touch the val_bpb measurement, the data, the seed lines or the evaluation call. It adds no bugs, so there are no grounds for a veto.
The candidate scored 1.1081, which is 0.0027 bpb worse than the incumbent mean of 1.1054. The negative sign of the reported z (-0.427) and the provisional reject agree with that.

I can't recompute z exactly. Only the mean of the incumbent's 2 runs is given, not the individual values or their spread. The reported z implies a spread of about 0.0063, which is plausible for run-to-run noise. Two incumbent runs and one candidate run give very little statistical power, but the difference is small and in the wrong direction, so rejecting is reasonable.
No claims accompany the numbers, so there is nothing to check against them.

description: Set FINAL_LR_FRAC from 0.0 to 0.001 so the learning rate ends at a tiny nonzero floor instead of zero.
Wrap each transformer block in non-reentrant torch.utils.checkpoint to cut activation memory, and raise DEVICE_BATCH_SIZE from 16 to 32 (same total batch).
